This is the formula sheet you will receive with Midterm 2 on **Tuesday, April 21, 2026**. It covers Modules 1–3 in CGS units.

Midterm 2 focuses on **Module 3 Lectures 1–8** (stellar timescales, hydrostatic equilibrium, nuclear fusion, radiation transport, stellar structure, mass limits, low-mass evolution, and the Chandrasekhar limit), with cumulative reference to Modules 1 and 2.
